deck_title: Gram-Schmidt tangent re-orthonormalization vs naive un-orthogonalized interpolated TBN skew rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Jørgen Peder Gram (1883) & Erhard Schmidt (1907) tangent re-orthonormalization (T_orth = normalize(T - dot(N, T) * N), B_orth = sigma * cross(N, T_orth), locking normal-tangent dot product N·T_orth = 0.0000 and TBN metric determinant squared det^2 = 1.0000x across all 17 interpolated tangent-shear stations (N·T)^2 = 0.75u in [0.0000, 0.7500]) versus naive un-orthogonalized interpolated TBN (which normalizes N and T independently without subtracting (N·T)N, causing bitangent B = cross(N, T) and TBN metric determinant squared to collapse as 1 - 0.75u down to 0.8125x at u=0.25, 0.6250x at u=0.50, and 0.2500x / ||B||=0.50x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Jacobi iterative orthonormalization.
